scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof and reproducing script supplied; no independent mathematical audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to denominators three and original consecutive generators from 3x-r through 3x-r+3 with x>=3 and r in {1,2}; it does not resolve general progression quotients. Exact finite checks supplement the unbounded proof. Earlier implicit specializations remain a priority risk.
title: Ternary quotients of four consecutive integers: exact Frobenius, genus and pseudo-Frobenius formulas
